reply_text:
Kwame, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to you was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's Dec 8 recap note in the public files also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff.

The same note says Bettina kept running PHL day to day through Nov 21 to finish the terminal cutover. You took over day-to-day on **November 22, 2025**.

For the CRM I'd use Nov 3 as the ownership change date. If the CRM field is for when you started running the account, use Nov 22.
